rows.names: What would have to change for a conformant form to exist: the routed act asks for a POSITIVE-SATISFIABILITY arm for x2-flag and x3-filed INSIDE check_lt_r1.py, dispatched by that checker's own CMD table. check_lt_r1.py is round 1's PINNED fixed input of a CLOSED round; no sibling document can add a CMD entry to another file's dispatch table -- that requires editing the pinned file itself, which this round's BOUNDS refuses by name (READ-ONLY, NOT ONE BYTE) and which LGIC_ENFORCE round 16's additive-sibling ruling (14d80144dd, EN-m-2) holds would 'ACTIVELY ENDANGER something graded'. The only conformant path is for round 1 to be re-opened (a decision this cell does not make) or for a future round that legitimately re-touches check_lt_r1.py to add the arm as part of that repair. No cell barred from editing the pinned input can satisfy this from any position.
